a2.level: mean of the 48 pooled per-circuit deltas

a4.what: fidelity-component pass probability at the n=12 decision scale (mean > min_delta AND inner-bootstrap CI excludes 0); the campaign cost gate (ratio <= 1.02) is NOT simulated
a4.subset_rule: 12 of 48 circuits per draw, without replacement, numpy default_rng(12); the same circuit subsets are reused across the pooled and per-rep libraries
a4.deviation: inner bootstrap uses 2000 resamples, not the campaign decision bootstrap's 5000 (src/metrics.py:128, paired_delta, seed 3): 10000 draws x 5000 resamples x 12 circuits was the nesting feasibility bound; 2000 is fixed here and stated up front. The inner rng(13) stream advances across draws within each effect level (fresh stream per level) — an approximation of the campaign's fresh-per-decision rng
